title: National Housing Finance and Investment Corporation Amendment (Unlocking Regional Housing) Bill 2023
short_title: National Housing Finance and Investment Corporation Amendment (Unlocking Regional Housing) Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change the National Housing Finance and Investment Corporation's functions and oversight to address housing infrastructure needs in regional, rural and remote Australia.
The corporation would proactively identify suitable projects and assist applicants, while giving the minister quarterly updates on funded projects and pending applications.
The minister would have to examine actions towards a regional share of at least 30 per cent of support and report on their response.
changes: At least one board member would need relevant expertise in regional, rural or remote housing needs.
Annual reports would show how financial support was distributed across states, territories, councils and regional areas.
The minister would need to publish a report explaining the Investment Mandate's exclusion of community facilities.
summary.affected: Regional communities, local councils, community housing providers and government-owned utilities are affected.
